description.en: Small oval leaves on slender twigs form an overlapping montane thicket along the right and lower margins, running off both edges.
description.zh: 细枝上的小卵叶在右缘与下缘叠成山地问灌丛，并自然越过画面边界。

design.motif: Small oval leaves, fine leaf clusters and slender woody twigs along the right and lower margins; matte gray-sage detail and soft brushed edges.
design.rationale: Hexly brand-texture rules give animal identities habitat foliage in the collection's shared language: quiet, tonal, low chroma, loosely arranged along the right and lower margins and continuing past the edges. Chamelo's mark is a chameleon that lives in montane shrub foliage, so the surface uses that thicket in the same construction as Rhino, Kite and Falcon instead of a specimen branch or a painted plaque.

contrast.method: WCAG relative luminance on the 320px card texture composited at surfaceOpacity over Hexly normal, hover and page surfaces. Body text is measured over the left 62% of the canvas, where text and controls actually sit; the right and lower foliage is decoration behind the card's empty column.

superseded: v1.0.8 had habitat foliage but built it as one pressed specimen branch: large separated leaves, a more saturated green, sharper photographic edges and an empty lower-right corner. v1.0.9 uses the collection's construction — small leaves on slender twigs, loose overlapping arrangement along the right and lower margins, gray-sage matte detail and foliage running off both edges.
